title: Service Manager: role permissions match the expected set
preconds: 1. A user is assigned the Service Manager role.
steps:
1. Open the Service Manager role's Permission Summary (eye icon on the Roles list).
  2. Check the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Work orders sub-settings, the View mode and the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Optionally log in as the user and spot-check a few of the role's typical tasks.
expected: The Service Manager permissions match the expected set: Work orders View/Create & Edit, Delete; Work order lines Create & Edit/Delete; Schedule full; Customers full; Part sales full; Catalog and Inventory full; Vendor and order management full; Invoicing & payments View/Create & Edit (no Delete); Reports on; Customer portal on; See Financial Data on; View and Manage AP/AR Data on; Settings limited to App Settings and View/Manage Wages; View mode Full View.
